rationale: The original runtime is reused. Only the obsolete live-source fingerprint calculation and baseline recompilation call are bypassed. All saved result files are retained; model and sample hash checks remain active.
interruptionAccounting: Logical call and elapsed-time totals include saved result records only. Requests in flight when the environment stopped may have reached the provider but their completion and billing cannot be established; they are not counted as confirmed completed calls.
